datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Kenya. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets representing IPC phase classifications for multiple scenarios and time periods in 2018.
